train_model: run the detectron model training loop with checkpointing and logging across GPU iterations
create_model: build a detectron model and find saved checkpoints to resume training from
setup_model_for_training: load saved weights and create the network in the Caffe2 workspace for training
optimize_memory: save GPU memory through blob sharing using Caffe2 memonger across all devices
dump_proto_files: save prototxt descriptions of the training network and parameter initialization network to disk
